authority: docs/FIELD_CANDIDATE_SUBFIELD_PROBE_20261019.md §预审后固定口径（S-01～S-06，D-279, commit 4732584） + D-279/D-280 + review/preflight.json status FIT_RELEASED (computation_authorized=true); this file supersedes the pre-release machine contract and never overrides the science contract
scope: single fixed K=2 two-component candidate field per target and fold; candidate molecular identity repeatability only (HF-03). Not field-to-field spatial recovery, not TLS structure, not an independent biological field, not HF-01
expression_source: data/other_sources/hest1k/st/{sid}.h5ad fields X, var/_index, obs/_index, obs/in_tissue only
split_file: infra/field_source_holdout_20261018/splits.json (frozen 11 splits: internal_0..4 over 72 sections / 65 units, source_0..5 over 53 sections / 47 units); never re-drawn; TENX23/TENX28 are absent from the 72 qualified sections

gene_split.rule: S-01: genes_t = sorted(set(panel[target])); perm = numpy.random.default_rng(0).permutation(len(genes_t)); order = genes_t[perm]; n_a = ceil(2*n/3); A = order[:n_a]; B = order[n_a:] (both kept in permuted order for loadings, sorted for reporting)
gene_split.remainder: the remainder n - n_a = floor(n/3) goes to B; B_AXIS 49 -> A 33 / B 16; each Hallmark 200 -> A 134 / B 66
gene_split.invariants: name-only, expression-free, computed once per target before any read; A and B disjoint; union equals the panel; never re-split after seeing detection or any held-out score; FC-03 gene lists not reused
gene_split.cross_target_note: targets analysed independently; a symbol can be A for one target and B for another (B_AXIS-B ∩ IFN-A = 2; IFN-B ∩ EMT-A = 2; IFN-A ∩ EMT-B = 1); target-wise results are not independent across targets

normalisation.D-279_rule: A and B gene maps both use log1p(1e4 * raw count / L_external), where per point L_external = total counts of ALL genes at that point MINUS counts of ALL panel genes of this target (A union B)
normalisation.why: B cannot enter the A denominator and A cannot enter the B denominator; stronger than excluding only B
normalisation.not_old_proxy_scale: this denominator differs from the old proxy whole-library denominator; results are never compared to old readout scores as the same scale
normalisation.zero_or_negative: points with L_external <= 0 are NOT_TESTABLE on both sides; no imputation with old proxy scores
normalisation.common_library_caveat: the shared external library can still induce technical correlation; reported as a separate sensitivity, never as independent truth

measurability_and_sampling.usable_A_rule: D-279: an A gene counts as measurable in a training UNIT only when EVERY section of that unit has >= 20 non-zero tissue spots (points with L_external > 0) and the unit-level training map variance > 0; the gene is usable in the fold only when it is measurable in at least HALF of the training units
measurability_and_sampling.A_fewer_than_6: if usable A < 6 in a fold, all four representations are NOT_TESTABLE; K is not lowered and the split is not changed
measurability_and_sampling.training_sample: per training unit at most 512 tissue points, using one COMMON fixed count n_sample = min(512, min available points over training units); equal per unit; a two-section unit shares the budget split as evenly as possible across its sections; seed 0
measurability_and_sampling.test_sampling: test units are NOT subsampled (all tissue points evaluated); no test-side gene selection or re-scaling
measurability_and_sampling.scaling: per-gene positive-value mean over the fold's training sample (a gene with no positive value is unusable); the SAME training scale is applied to test points
measurability_and_sampling.unit_rule_note: per-section threshold inside every unit; a two-section unit is measurable only if both sections pass; feasibility.json counts (16-18 etc.) are diagnostics only and are NOT the usable gene list

model.settings: sklearn NMF(n_components=K, init='nndsvda', solver='cd', random_state=0, max_iter=500, tol=1e-4); no algorithm switch on failure
model.training_input: sampled training points x usable A genes, non-negative after scaling
model.projection: test points projected onto the frozen training loadings using A only (NMF.transform); no B, no test-side refit

not_testable.ZERO_LOADING: a component loading vector is all zero
not_testable.NON_FINITE: any NaN/Inf in loadings or training factor

alignment.cross_fold: pairwise cosine between training loadings, descriptive only; never used for test prediction or model selection
alignment.cross_fold_floor: shared measurable A < 6 makes cross-fold matching NOT_ESTIMABLE
alignment.similarity: component similarity is reported only; no post-hoc 'two fields' threshold
alignment.in_fold_resamples: fixed 5 resamples, each a 90% without-replacement row subsample of the frozen training sample with seeds 0-4; each refit is paired to the full-training fit by the larger sum of cosines over the two 1-1 pairings on shared A genes; ties keep the original order; resample loadings are never used for prediction

references.same_information: A_mean, K=1, K=2, single_gene (highest training A contribution among usable A) and all usable A genes all come from the SAME fold, SAME A list and SAME training sample
references.single_gene_rule: chosen by the mean of the UNSCALED training gene map among usable A genes (never by a test B gene); the represented map used for B mapping is that gene's training-scaled map so all arms share one input scale
references.B_mapping: for each B gene, each representation is fitted with StandardScaler (training points) + Ridge(alpha=10) to that B gene map; test uses the training transform
references.full_A_ridge: the all-A Ridge is a stronger same-information reference; no claim of equal parameter count
references.B_role: B maps are target values only; B never enters any representation, training standardisation, test projection or model selection; parameters, B-component association and direction come only from training units

B_evaluation.test_evaluable: a B gene in a test section needs >= 20 non-zero tissue spots and gene-map variance > 0; otherwise NOT_TESTABLE for that gene x section (no imputation, never written as negative)
B_evaluation.q75: high set = v > quantile(v, 0.75) per map; an empty high set or a constant map makes the Jaccard NOT_ESTIMABLE
B_evaluation.per_gene_metrics: Pearson (NOT_ESTIMABLE if either map constant), q75 Jaccard, gene-specificity vs the all-A reference; all B genes and all reasons reported
B_evaluation.aggregation: per B gene per section; a gene x unit is excluded if any necessary section is not evaluable; then complete units equally weighted; gene x section rows are never averaged directly

technical.covariates: point-level depth = total counts of genes OUTSIDE the target's whole A union B panel, detection = fraction of those genes with a positive count
technical.reporting: raw maps and technical sensitivity reported separately; residual changes cannot alone decide biological vs technical origin; no post-hoc thresholds

claim_ceiling: even a stable, non-redundant, B-supported composition is only a candidate field; molecular co-direction is not independent pathology truth, not an independent biological field, not HF-01
old_probe_not_used: 2026-10-06 FC-03 scores, its 4213 vs 23 learned-factor information budget, K=8 stability and the 0.5 success line are not reused, not a baseline, and not a reason to keep or drop a target
identity_and_scope: 8 within-study confirmed units; 57 units unknown and never upgraded; 19 source-insufficient sections stay internal; lung cannot enter a source holdout; breast (source_5) and liver (source_0) are cross-organ; section counts are never patient counts
release_gate: the run stage refuses to start without a review release file (review/preflight.json with implementation_approved=true and computation_authorized=true)
not_run: human TLS labels / old manual evaluation / HookNet
